opportunities.name: Leverage paired attacker
opportunities.objective: Test leverage paired attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Leverage's unmarked attack and allied mark consumption each scale max-health magic damage with AP; Nashor adds owner attack pressure and Dusk and Dawn follows E shielding. This route relies on a partner consuming marks repeatedly, not on Renata attacking one marked target alone.
opportunities.requiredState: An ally damages each mark before Renata reapplies it.
opportunities.failure: Solo attacks leave a persistent mark and lose the hoped-for passive cadence.
opportunities.test: Count marks applied and consumed with an ally versus isolated attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade-style extra hits cannot consume the mark as an allied champion.

opportunities.name: Bailout shield charge engine
opportunities.objective: Test bailout shield charge engine against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Loyalty Program shields allies for three seconds while damaging champions, fitting Helia's damage-charge then ally-shield heal cycle. Handshake root fits Mandate's current vulnerability and immobilizing-ability haste; Bailout's attack/movement buff rewards keeping an ally alive for the required takedown.
opportunities.requiredState: E hits both enemy and ally and W recipient can finish a victim.
opportunities.failure: Healing merely delays Bailout decay and cannot replace the takedown.
opportunities.test: Measure Helia healing and time gained during decay without a kill.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bailout cannot permanently prevent death through unlimited external healing.

ruledOut.reason: Rageblade-style extra hits cannot consume the mark as an allied champion.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Leverage paired attacker
builds.summary: Test leverage paired attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test leverage paired attacker against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Leverage's unmarked attack and allied mark consumption each scale max-health magic damage with AP; Nashor adds owner attack pressure and Dusk and Dawn follows E shielding. This route relies on a partner consuming marks repeatedly, not on Renata attacking one marked target alone.
testPlan: Required state: An ally damages each mark before Renata reapplies it.
Count marks applied and consumed with an ally versus isolated attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Solo attacks leave a persistent mark and lose the hoped-for passive cadence.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade-style extra hits cannot consume the mark as an allied champion.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for [2] seconds. Allies hit gain [50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110 + (0.5) × AP] Shield for [3] seconds.

Renata's Attacks mark enemies for [6] seconds and deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.

Renata infuses an ally champion, granting [(10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.01)] Attack Speed and [(10 / 12.5 / 15 / 17.5 / 20 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.01)] Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to [(10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.02)] Attack Speed and [(10 / 12.5 / 15 / 17.5 / 20 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.02)] Move Speed over [5] seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff.

If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds.

If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to [20]% max Health and stop decaying.

The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.

Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for [1] second and dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for [0.5] seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.
